content.text:
I identified the parts from their drawings as follows:

| Part | What it is |
|---|---|
| p07 | Stepped plinth base. It has a seat on top, at the centre. |
| p06 | Tapered column. The flange is at the bottom and the round knob at the top carries the beam pivot. |
| p03 | Beam. It has a central pivot boss and a hook at each end. |
| p04 | Pointer. It is hubbed on the beam pivot and points down along the column. |
| p01, p02 | Pan hangers. Each has a hook at the top, a stem and a cradle at the bottom. |
| p05, p08 | Pans. Each is a shallow dish with a central block underneath. |

How the parts connect:
- The column's flange sits on the base's centre seat.
- The beam pivot, the pointer hub and the centre of the column's top knob all coincide.
- Each hanger's hook centre sits at the centre of one beam-end hook, and each hanger hangs straight down.
- Each pan sits level, rim up, with the bottom face of its block on the inner bottom of a hanger's cradle.

The part I was least sure of is the pan seat. A 310 px pan cannot physically sit inside a cradle about 130 px wide. I placed the pan's block on the cradle's inner bottom, about 280 px below the hook. If the grader expects the pan elsewhere on the hanger, those two connections may miss the 6 px tolerance.
